packs.name: detection_context
packs.description: What a sensor detection is about: the rule category, the sensor, the process event (atom, parent, hash, path, command line, user) and how often the same rule and the same host raised detections in the last 7 days.
packs.brief: What a detection is about: rule, sensor, process event, noise

exports.name: found
exports.description: True when the detection exists and is visible to the caller.

exports.name: cat
exports.description: The detection category (the rule).

exports.name: sid
exports.description: The sensor the detection fired on.

exports.name: hostname
exports.description: The sensor's host name.

exports.name: event_type
exports.description: The type of the triggering event.

exports.name: atom
exports.description: The triggering event's atom (use it with process_tree).

exports.name: parent_atom
exports.description: The triggering event's parent atom, when it has one.

exports.name: hash
exports.description: The file hash in the triggering event, when there is one (use it with hash_spread).

exports.name: file_path
exports.description: The file or image path in the triggering event.

exports.name: command_line
exports.description: The command line in the triggering event.

exports.name: user_name
exports.description: The user in the triggering event.

exports.name: gen_time
exports.description: When the detection was generated.

exports.name: host_detection_count
exports.description: Detections on the same sensor in the last 7 days.

exports.name: same_rule_count
exports.description: Detections of the same rule across the org in the last 7 days.

packs.name: domain_reputation
packs.description: What the org's own telemetry says about a domain: how many sensors have seen it, whether any sensor looked it up in the last 7 days, and the mail the org received from it. Internal history only: it is not a third party reputation.
packs.brief: What the org telemetry knows about a domain: sensors, DNS, mail

exports.name: sensors_30d
exports.description: Sensors that saw the domain in the last 30 days (lagging index: zero is not proof of absence).
exports.brief: sensors that saw it, 30d (lagging: 0 is not proof)

exports.name: sensors_365d
exports.description: Sensors that saw the domain in the last 365 days.

exports.name: looked_up_7d
exports.description: True when a sensor looked the domain up in the last 7 days (a positive answer is final; a negative one is only as complete as the fact says).
exports.brief: a sensor looked it up in 7d (true is final)

exports.name: first_lookup
exports.description: The first matching DNS event found, when there is one.

exports.name: mail_known
exports.description: False when the mail index holds no mail from the domain.
exports.brief: false if no mail from it was ever indexed

exports.name: mail_messages_30d
exports.description: Messages received from the domain in the last 30 days.

exports.name: mail_flagged_180d
exports.description: Messages from the domain that were flagged in the last 180 days.

exports.name: mail_first_seen
exports.description: When the org first received mail from the domain (RFC 3339, empty when never).
exports.brief: when mail from it was first seen

packs.name: hash_spread
packs.description: How many sensors of the org ran a file hash in the last day, week, month and year. The count comes from a lagging index: zero is never proof that nobody ran it.
packs.brief: How many sensors ran a file hash (1d/7d/30d/365d; lagging)

params.name: hash
params.description: The file hash (SHA-256 or the hash the sensors report).

exports.name: seen
exports.description: True when any window counted at least one sensor.

exports.name: hosts_1d
exports.description: Sensors that ran it in the last day.

exports.name: hosts_7d
exports.description: Sensors that ran it in the last 7 days.

exports.name: hosts_30d
exports.description: Sensors that ran it in the last 30 days.

exports.name: hosts_365d
exports.description: Sensors that ran it in the last 365 days.

packs.name: host_context
packs.description: Who and what a sensor is: its directory entity, host name, owner and the sensors the entity has. Unresolved (or ambiguous) when the directory cannot say, never guessed.
packs.brief: Who and what a sensor is: directory entity, name, owner

params.name: sid
params.description: The sensor id (a UUID) of the host.

exports.name: resolved
exports.description: True when the sensor maps to exactly one directory entity.
exports.brief: sensor maps to exactly one entity

exports.name: entity_id
exports.description: The host's directory entity id (use it with entity.get or entity.activity).

exports.name: hostname
exports.description: The host's display name.

exports.name: kind
exports.description: The entity kind, normally host.

exports.name: sids
exports.description: The sensor ids of the entity's telemetry sources.

exports.name: open_findings
exports.description: Open cloud security findings across the entity's cloud accounts.

exports.name: owner_id
exports.description: The entity id of the host's first owner.

exports.name: owner_name
exports.description: The display name of the host's first owner.

packs.name: message_outcome
packs.description: A mail message and what became of it: the verdict, the rule decision, the signals that fired, where its link lands (derived, not crawled) and, per recipient, whether their own machine contacted the landing domain after delivery.
packs.brief: A mail message and what became of it: verdict, link, clicks

exports.name: sender
exports.description: The sender's address.

exports.name: sender_domain
exports.description: The sender's domain.

exports.name: subject
exports.description: The subject.

exports.name: received
exports.description: When the message was received (RFC 3339).

exports.name: state
exports.description: The copy's state, for example delivered or quarantined.

exports.name: verdict
exports.description: The AI verdict, for example benign or suspicious.

exports.name: fired_signals
exports.description: The ids of the signals that fired.

exports.name: decision
exports.description: The newest rule decision: rule, action, whether it was carried out.

exports.name: recipient_count
exports.description: How many recipients got a copy.

exports.name: final_domain
exports.description: Where the focus link lands (derived from its redirect parameter, not crawled).

exports.name: open_redirect
exports.description: True when the link goes through an open redirector to somewhere other than the shown site.
exports.brief: link goes via an open redirector

exports.name: via_tracker
exports.description: True when the link goes through a click tracker that lands on the shown site.
exports.brief: link goes via a click tracker

exports.name: any_clicked
exports.description: True when at least one recipient's machine looked up the landing domain after delivery.
exports.brief: a recipient machine looked up the landing domain

exports.name: clicked
exports.description: The mailboxes that clicked.

exports.name: per_recipient
exports.description: Per recipient: outcome clicked, possible, not_clicked or unknown, and the machine checked.

packs.name: org_roster
packs.description: The org's people and machines: counts, then one page of machines (sensor id, hostname, platform, online, last seen, owner name and email) and the people who own them, from the sensor list and the directory. Offline machines stay listed. A person with no machine is not listed.
packs.brief: The org's people and machines: counts, machines, owners

params.name: limit
params.description: Machines per page (1..200, default 50). Pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page.

params.name: online_only
params.description: Only machines online now. Default false: every machine, online or not.

params.name: selector
params.description: A sensor selector to narrow the machines, for example plat == `windows`.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The next_cursor of the previous page.

exports.name: machine_count
exports.description: Machines in this page.

exports.name: online_count
exports.description: Machines of this page that are online.

exports.name: offline_count
exports.description: Machines of this page that are offline (still listed).

exports.name: people_count
exports.description: Distinct owners in this page.

exports.name: unowned_count
exports.description: Machines whose owner the directory does not give.

exports.name: owner_lookup
exports.description: How the owners were read: ok, partial, unavailable or skipped.

exports.name: more
exports.description: True when there may be another page: a page shorter than the limit is the last one, a page of exactly the limit can be followed by an empty page.

exports.name: next_cursor
exports.description: The cursor of the next page (present when more is true).
exports.brief: pass as cursor for the next page

exports.name: machines
exports.description: The machines: sid, hostname, platform, online, last_seen, owner_id, owner, owner_email (sorted by hostname).
exports.brief: sid, hostname, platform, online, last_seen, owner(_email)

exports.name: people
exports.description: The owners: entity_id, name, email (the org's usual address), emails (all addresses the directory lists), machines (hostnames), sorted by name.

packs.name: process_tree
packs.description: The process around an event: the event, its parent event, and what the process did (child events, the domains it looked up, the addresses it reached).
packs.brief: The process around an event: parent, children, domains, addresses

params.name: sid
params.description: The sensor id the event was recorded on.

params.name: atom
params.description: The atom id of the process event (a detection's atom).

exports.name: event_type
exports.description: The event type, for example NEW_PROCESS.

exports.name: hostname
exports.description: The sensor's host name.

exports.name: fields
exports.description: The event's own fields (image path, command line, hashes: they depend on the event type).

exports.name: parent_atom
exports.description: The atom of the parent event.

exports.name: parent_type
exports.description: The parent event's type.

exports.name: parent_fields
exports.description: The parent event's own fields.

exports.name: child_count
exports.description: How many events have this one as their parent.

exports.name: children
exports.description: The child events (type, atom, time, fields).

exports.name: domains
exports.description: The domains the process looked up.

exports.name: destinations
exports.description: The addresses the process connected to.

packs.name: sender_reputation
packs.description: The org's own mail history of a sender and its domain: whether it was ever seen, how much mail in the last 30 days, how many were flagged, and whether this is a first-time sender. Not a third party reputation.
packs.brief: The org's own mail history of a sender and its domain

params.name: before
params.description: A time (RFC 3339, usually the message's own): adds prior_messages_30d, the mail the sender wrote before it.

params.name: exclude_group
params.description: A message group_id to leave out of prior_messages_30d (the message under investigation).

exports.name: known
exports.description: False when the org never received mail from the sender.
exports.brief: false if never received mail from it

exports.name: messages_30d
exports.description: Messages from the sender in the last 30 days.

exports.name: prior_messages_30d
exports.description: Messages from the sender in the 30 days before `before` (only with before): 0 means a first-time sender.
exports.brief: its messages in the 30d before `before` (0 = first-time)

exports.name: distinct_recipients
exports.description: How many different mailboxes received mail from the sender.
exports.brief: mailboxes that got mail from it

exports.name: flagged_180d
exports.description: How many of the sender's messages were flagged in the last 180 days.

exports.name: first_seen
exports.description: When the org first received mail from the sender (RFC 3339, empty when never).
exports.brief: when mail from it was first seen

exports.name: domain_messages_30d
exports.description: Messages from the whole domain in the last 30 days.

exports.name: domain_known
exports.description: False when the org never received mail from the domain.
exports.brief: false if never received mail from the domain

exports.name: domain_flagged_180d
exports.description: Messages from the domain that were flagged in the last 180 days.

packs.name: user_activity
packs.description: Who an email address is and what happened around them: the directory entity, their first laptop, account facts and their detections and activity per source in a window.
packs.brief: Who an email address is: entity, profile, laptop, detections

params.name: window
params.description: The time range as [start, end] (default the last 7 days; the start may not be earlier than 30 days ago).

exports.name: resolved
exports.description: True when the address maps to exactly one directory entity.
exports.brief: address maps to exactly one entity

exports.name: entity_id
exports.description: The user's directory entity id.

exports.name: display_name
exports.description: The user's display name.

exports.name: department
exports.description: The profile's department.

exports.name: job_title
exports.description: The profile's job title.

exports.name: account_status
exports.description: The account status in the first directory source.

exports.name: mfa
exports.description: Whether MFA is enrolled, as the directory source reports it.
exports.brief: MFA enrolled, as the directory says

exports.name: laptop_name
exports.description: The display name of the first machine the user owns.

exports.name: laptop_sids
exports.description: The sensor ids of that machine.

exports.name: detection_count
exports.description: Detections about the user in the window.
exports.brief: detections about the user in the window

exports.name: detections
exports.description: The detections (id, category, time, sensor).

exports.name: sources
exports.description: Per activity source (email, detections, sensor, cloud): status and item count.
